page.content:
The last airbender and Avatar of his age.

How Aang connects

  • Series: Avatar: The Last Airbender (series) — The original series is Aang's story as the last airbender.
  • Faction: Air Nomads — Aang is the last surviving Air Nomad.
  • Faction: The Gaang — Aang is the Avatar the Gaang travels to restore.
  • Character: Ozai — Aang's war ends in a confrontation with Ozai.
  • Character: Appa — Appa is Aang's sky bison and animal guide.
  • Concept: Avatar State — Aang enters the Avatar State when past lives seize the fight.
  • Concept: Avatar cycle — Aang is the Avatar of his turn in the cycle.
  • Concept: Energybending — Aang uses energybending to strip Ozai of firebending.

What is Aang?

Aang is the Air Nomad boy who fled his destiny, slept in an iceberg a hundred years, and must master all four elements before Sozin's Comet.

Key threads lead to Avatar: The Last Airbender (series), Air Nomads, The Gaang, Ozai, Appa and Avatar State.
